title: The Black Jew Wealth Coach - Article Draft
description: Structured Draft 1 SEO article package for The Black Jew Wealth Coach and Brandon Gardner.

request_id.description: The exact Request ID supplied by the research step in the format BWC-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.

draft_version.description: Draft version. For the initial article generation, return Draft 1.

content_type.description: Content type supplied by the research step, normally SEO Blog.

topic_area.description: Primary subject area supplied by the research step.

target_audience.description: Specific audience the article is written for.

business_goal.description: Primary business objective the article should support.

related_service.description: Relevant Brandon Gardner service supplied by the research step. Return an empty string when none applies.

related_book.description: Relevant Brandon Gardner book supplied by the research step. Return an empty string when none applies.

seo_title.description: Compelling SEO-optimized title based on the article topic, primary keyword, search intent, and supplied research. Avoid clickbait and unsupported promises.

meta_description.description: Concise SEO meta description accurately summarizing the article and encouraging an appropriate search click. Use the primary keyword naturally when appropriate.

url_slug.description: Concise SEO-friendly URL slug using lowercase words separated by hyphens.

primary_keyword.description: Primary SEO keyword selected from the supplied research and used naturally throughout the article.

secondary_keywords.description: Relevant supporting SEO keywords and semantic variations separated by semicolons. Do not keyword stuff.

article_draft.description: Complete, substantive Draft 1 SEO article for The Black Jew Wealth Coach and Brandon Gardner. Write in clean Markdown with a strong introduction, detailed H2 sections, useful H3 subsections where appropriate, practical explanations, actionable guidance, and a conclusion. Use the supplied research, search intent, Ubersuggest data, competitor gaps, unique content angle, recommended outline, and AI recommendation. Do not return an outline, summary, synopsis, or abbreviated article. Do not invent clients, testimonials, case studies, success stories, statistics, studies, quotes, financial results, grants, programs, laws, rates, requirements, organizations, or factual claims. Clearly label any illustrative example as hypothetical. The article is Draft 1 awaiting Brandon Gardner's review and must not imply that it has been approved or published.

article_word_count.description: Approximate word count of article_draft only.

faq_section.description: Three to five relevant questions and substantive answers informed by search intent, People Also Ask, related searches, and the article topic. Do not invent factual claims.

internal_link_suggestions.description: Relevant internal content or service-page opportunities for The Black Jew Wealth Coach. Provide page or article topics separated clearly. Do not invent live URLs.

external_authority_links.description: Relevant credible external authority resources supported by the supplied research. Never fabricate URLs. If an exact verified URL is unavailable, provide the organization or resource name.

image_prompt.description: One detailed article-specific premium editorial photography prompt for The Black Jew Wealth Coach. The image should communicate the article topic with authentic people, realistic activity, contemporary environments, natural expressions, realistic skin tones, editorial lighting, visual depth, and a premium financial or entrepreneurial aesthetic. Avoid generic stock imagery, fake wealth imagery, piles of cash, oversized dollar signs, unrelated luxury settings, cartoons, stereotypes, logos, watermarks, headlines, or text embedded in the image.

image_alt_text.description: Concise, accessible alt text accurately describing the proposed featured image. Do not keyword stuff.

cta.description: Relevant, credible call to action connecting the reader with The Black Jew Wealth Coach, Brandon Gardner, or an appropriate supplied service or resource. Do not guarantee financial outcomes.

quality_review.description: Brief editorial quality assessment covering search intent, article depth, SEO structure, readability, keyword use, brand alignment, factual caution, unsupported claims, financial-content safeguards, CTA relevance, image-brand alignment, and readiness for Brandon Gardner to review. Identify anything Brandon should verify before publication. Do not mark the article as finally approved.
